# J4 · Điều chỉnh kế hoạch

Group **J · Patient 360 đầy đủ · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › modal plan-edit · buổi đã hoàn tất giữ nguyên

## Logic source
- Web: modal plan-edit · buổi đã hoàn tất giữ nguyên
- Web `prototype/shared/clinic.js` › patient360() tabs (consult, plan, session, photos, finance, crm, history) and modalHtml(type) (note, plan-edit, message, edit, care); `care-finance.js`, `crm-ui.js`.
- Web modal 'plan-edit' + save-plan; `updateTreatmentPlan` (total ≥ sessions done, ≤ 20).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.PlanEdit` ("plan-edit") · app bar "Điều chỉnh kế hoạch"
- Composable: `PlanEditScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/Patient360Clinical.kt`
- Registered by graph: `patient360ClinicalGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `addDays`, `approveAiBrief`, `approveConsultDraft`, `brief`, `generateConsultDraft`, `patient`, `recordTreatmentSession`, `saveClinicalNote`, `staffContext`, `updateTreatmentPlan`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/Patient360ClinicalShotTest.kt:64` → `pema-kmp/feature/patients/build/shots/J4-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/J4.png`

## Required canvas text (keep verbatim)
- Chỉ đổi tên và số buổi dự kiến. Buổi đã ghi nhận không bị sửa.

## Business rules
- Entry point: the "Patient 360 đầy đủ" item in F1, filtered by role.
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner/doctor); other roles see "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." / hidden buttons, like `staff-context.js apply()`.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Web seed data instead of illustrative names/dates.
